datasets.title: Little Dumbbell Nebula in visible light
datasets.description: ESA/Hubble's photograph of the Little Dumbbell Nebula, in g 475, [O III] 502, H-alpha 656, [N II] 658 and I 814 nm, on the nebula's own shape. From spectra, Bryce et al. (1996) found a ring seen nearly edge-on, the bright bar, with a lobe blown out of each open end, the north-western one toward us. The picture lies on that surface: the ring's size, the lobes' reach and the tilt are the paper's, and the lobes' width is measured on the picture. The side toward the Sun is the photograph; the side away from it was never photographed and repeats it.
datasets.summary: Hubble's picture on the nebula's ring and two lobes as spectra place them; the far side repeats the picture.
